I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread. The yard supervisor at Quillfeather's Bozeman warehouse wants Dock Door 4 flagged as out of service in Pemberline Dock during the second shift, for a hydraulic leveler repair.

The source is Nadia's post in #strategic-random on Oct 13, which Ruth is a member of. I found nothing showing the change has been made, and no end date was given. I said that in the reply.
